messages:
Nina (CSM): Morning team — kicking off onboarding for DeepWave (enterprise pilot). Goal is a live pilot in ~6 weeks. Need alignment on stakeholders, success criteria, and any obvious renewal risks up front. I'll draft a 30/60/90 and a short health dashboard.

Carlos (Solutions Eng): I can own integration sessions. Need API keys, example payloads, and the dataset schema from the customer.

Priya (Success Ops): I will assemble the enablement checklist and a runbook. Linking our playbook: https://redwood.internal/playbooks/onboard-template (private).

Evan (Product): I'll own model/quality targets. Proposed initial success criteria: p95 latency <200ms, core-intent accuracy >=90%, and <5% hallucination rate on acceptance set.

Marta (Security): Please share network diagram + data residency requirements. If DeepWave needs EU-only storage, we need to flag for Private deployment early.

Sam (Customer): FYI — internal stakeholders: Lena (Eng), Omar (Infra), Zoe (Legal). PM is me (Sam). We can get keys once Lena signs the NDA.

Carlos (Solutions Eng): Great — I'll add Lena and Omar to the integration invite. Do we have a preferred window for the kickoff?

Sam (Customer): Tue/Wed mornings PST work best for us.

Nina (CSM): Proposed timeline (high-level):
- Week 0: kickoff + discovery
- Week 1: infra access + keys
- Week 2: integration + smoke tests
- Week 3: enablement workshop + early evals
- Week 4: pilot traffic ramp
- Week 5: monitoring + iterate
- Week 6: go/no-go review + renewal signal check

Priya (Success Ops): I'll run the enablement workshop in Week 3. Need sample prompts, top 50 test cases, and an eval set from the customer by end of Week 1.

Evan (Product): Adding to runbook: include a smoke/regression eval and a tiny harness command for ops. Example we use:
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' -d '{"model":"rw-small","input":"<test prompt>"}'
```

Nina (CSM): I'll put together a one-pager with responsibilities, the timeline above, and the dashboard KPIs (traffic, activation %, errors, latency). Will post by EOD.

deploy-bot: calendar invite created: "DeepWave Onboard Kickoff" Tue 10:00am PST — https://calendar.internal/event/abc123

Priya (Success Ops): Quick ask re: renewal risk — let's define an early adoption trigger. Suggest: if active usage <30% of target by end of Week 4, escalate to AM + Solutions Eng for rapid remediation.

Nina (CSM): Agreed. I'll add that as an automated alert in the health dashboard and set the weekly report cadence. :thumbsup:

Carlos (Solutions Eng): I'll prep a troubleshooting checklist for the most common integration errors (auth, payload schema, content-filtering).

Sam (Customer): Thanks — appreciate the clarity. I'll push the NDA to Zoe and Lena today.

Nina (CSM): Perfect. Action items: Carlos = invites & troubleshooting checklist; Priya = workshop + checklist; Evan = eval targets/runbook; Marta = security gating; Sam = internal approvals + schema. I'll share the one-pager and the Jira board links in this thread once created.

Priya (Success Ops): noted.

Marta (Security): noted, will start data residency scoping.

Nina (CSM): Closing loop — next update Friday with one-pager and calendar confirmed. Thanks everyone.
